title: Pip and the Sleepy Sunflower Seed
moral: Good things grow when we wait patiently and keep caring.
summary: Pip the little fox gets a tiny sunflower seed from Nana Hoot and wants it to grow RIGHT NOW! With help from his best friend Tumble, a rainy day and a lot of waiting, Pip discovers what happens when you give something time to grow. A gentle animated story about patience for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and Tumble's Wobbly Shape House
moral: When we work together, we can build amazing things.
summary: Nana Hoot brings a wheelbarrow full of wooden shapes, and Pip and Tumble each want to build a playhouse all by themselves. Wobbly squares, a banana-shaped triangle and one giant sneeze later, can they find a better way? Learn circles, squares, triangles, stars and hearts in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and Tumble's Sink-or-Float Rescue
moral: Kind friends always find a way to help, even the littlest ones.
summary: A teeny ladybug named Dot is stuck on a rock in the middle of Lily Pond! To help her, Pip, Tumble and Nana Hoot need a boat that floats, so they test a rock, an apple, a spoon and a leaf. Learn what sinks and what floats in this funny, kind animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Rainbow Paint Splash
moral: Telling the truth makes our hearts feel light and happy.
summary: It's Rainbow Day, and Nana Hoot has seven pots of paint for a giant rainbow! But Pip can't wait, and one super-duper spin later there's a big blue SPLOOSH. Learn red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet in this funny animated story about honesty for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Topsy-Turvy Treasure Map
moral: When we stop and listen, we find the best treasures together.
summary: Nana Hoot draws a treasure map full of opposite clues: up and down, fast and slow, hot and cold! Pip is in such a hurry that he forgets to listen, and things get very wibble-wobbly. Can Pip and Tumble follow the clues and find the treasure?

title: Pip and Tumble's Five-Senses Thank-You
moral: Saying thank you makes everyone's heart feel warm.
summary: Nana Hoot helps everybody in Clover Wood, so Pip and Tumble plan a secret thank-you surprise for all five of her senses! A giant sneeze, some very sour berries and one prickly pinecone later, will their surprise be ready? Learn to see, hear, smell, taste and touch in this funny animated story about gratitude for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Tumble and the Ten-Jump Skipping Rope
moral: If you don't get it the first time, keep trying, and you'll get a little better every time.
summary: It's Skipping Day in Clover Wood, and whoever does ten jumps in a row wins a shiny star ribbon! Count from one to ten with Pip, Tumble and Nana Hoot as Tumble bonks, wobbles, tangles and sneezes his way through some very silly tries.

title: Pip and the Big Bug Hotel
moral: Even the tiniest creatures need a safe home, so let's be gentle with nature.
summary: Pip wants Nana Hoot's garden super-duper tidy for her party, so he sweeps every leaf and stick... until a tap-tap-tapping under an old log changes everything! Meet ladybugs, ants, bees and butterflies, and learn how many legs an insect has in this funny animated story about caring for nature, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Sandcastle Sorry Rhyme
moral: When we say sorry and help fix things, our friendships grow even stronger.
summary: Pip and Tumble spend a sunny day at Sunny Bay beach, building sandcastles and playing a silly rhyme game. But one big BOING of a beach ball changes everything! Learn rhyming words like sun and fun, shell and bell, and boat, goat and coat in this funny animated story about saying sorry, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and Tumble's Super Helper Week
moral: When we help at home, everyone in the family feels happy.
summary: Nana Hoot is so busy with chores that she falls asleep standing up! So Pip and Tumble promise to be her helpers for one whole week. Learn the seven days of the week, from Monday to Sunday, in this funny animated story full of sneezes, splooshes and bubbles, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Tumble and the Wild Weather Walk
moral: Being brave means feeling a little scared and trying anyway.
summary: Pip has never touched real snow, so Nana Hoot leads Pip and Tumble up, up, UP Tall Top Mountain! On the way they meet sunshine, wild wind, splashy rain and soft white snow, but Tumble feels a little scared. Learn four kinds of weather in this funny animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Peep-Peep Mystery
moral: When we are curious and gentle, we discover wonderful new things.
summary: Pip hears a teeny, tiny peep-peep and just HAS to find out who made it! With Tumble and Nana Hoot he meets ducklings, a lamb and a calf on a giggly Baby Animal Hunt. Learn the names of baby animals in this funny animated story about curiosity for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Super Salad Picnic
moral: When we share, everyone's tummy and heart feel full.
summary: Pip the fox wants to make the biggest salad ever for the Harvest Picnic! With Tumble and Nana Hoot he picks apples, strawberries, carrots and lettuce, with lots of BOINGs, BONKs and one giant sneeze along the way. Learn the difference between fruits and vegetables in this funny animated story about sharing for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Pattern Party Flags
moral: When big feelings come, take a slow breath, and then fix things together.
summary: Pip has a super-duper important job: making a long string of party flags in a pattern for the Lantern Party! But one giant AH-CHOO from Tumble sends the flags flying, and Pip gets a big, stompy, cross feeling. Learn simple patterns like red, blue, red, blue in this funny animated story about managing big feelings, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Tumble and the Teeny-Tiny Door
moral: Big or small, you are just right being you.
summary: Tumble the baby elephant bonks his head on Pip's teeny-tiny door and wishes he were small! But when Nana Hoot's giant pumpkin and a very small hole need help, Tumble and Pip find out something special. Learn BIG and small in this funny animated story about being yourself, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Cock-a-Doodle Mix-Up
moral: When a friend feels poorly, a little kindness helps them feel better.
summary: Rosie the rooster has a sore throat and can't sing her wake-up song! Pip is sure he knows ALL the animal sounds... but his cock-a-doodle comes out as a MOO and an OINK! Learn what cows, pigs, sheep, ducks, hens and roosters say in this funny, kind animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and Hazel's I Spy Hello
learning: first letters of words (A is for apple)
moral: A gentle hello and a game to share can turn someone new into a friend.
summary: Someone new has moved into Clover Wood: Hazel, a teeny, shy hedgehog! Pip zooms over to say hello with a BONK, and Tumble's hello comes out as a HONK. Play I Spy and learn first letters like A for apple and S for snail in this funny animated story about making a new friend, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Tumble and Nana's Wiggle-Waggle Dance
moral: When we listen to our elders and help them, we learn wonderful things.
summary: Tonight is the Harvest Hop, and Pip and Tumble need a dance! Wise Nana Hoot knows the silly Wiggle-Waggle dance, but can Tumble find his knees and reach his toes? Pat your head, touch your nose and learn the parts of the body in this funny animated story about listening to and helping our elders, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Big Breakfast Wagon
moral: When we work together, even big jobs become easy and fun.
summary: Nana Hoot's little red wagon is full of breakfast for her neighbours, but a giant AH-CHOO blows away all the name tags! Can Pip, Tumble and Hazel work out who eats carrots, acorns, seeds and grass? Learn what animals eat in this funny animated story about teamwork, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Super-Duper Soapy Paws
moral: Washing our hands and brushing our teeth help us stay healthy and strong.
summary: After a morning of puddle jumping, Pip, Tumble and Hazel are muddy from nose to tail, and Nana Hoot's blueberry muffins are waiting! Learn the five steps of hand washing and how often to brush your teeth in this funny, bubbly animated story about healthy habits, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip Can't Wait for the Moon!
moral: Good things are worth waiting for, and waiting is easier when we help each other.
summary: Tonight is the Moon Party on Clover Hill, but it's only morning, and Pip the little fox can't wait! Can Pip, Tumble and Hazel make it night with scarves, floppy ears and a picnic blanket? Learn about day and night, the sun, the moon and the stars in this funny animated story about patience, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Tumble and the Huffy-Puffy Balloon
moral: When big feelings come, slow down, use your senses, and let friends help.
summary: Tumble the baby elephant has the biggest, reddest balloon at the Clover Wood Fair, until a gusty wind blows it into the tall oak tree! Can Pip, Hazel and Nana Hoot help Tumble with his huffy-puffy feeling? Learn to see, hear, smell, taste and touch in this funny animated story about managing big feelings, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Sleepy Chrysalis
moral: Good things take time, so we wait with patient, kind hearts.
summary: Pip finds a sparkly green chrysalis in Nana Hoot's garden and wants the butterfly to come out RIGHT NOW! A bonk, a wake-up song and one giant sneeze later, can Pip learn to wait? Learn the seven days of the week, from Monday to Sunday, in this funny animated story about patience for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Trail of Ten Acorns
moral: When we wonder, ask questions and look closely, we discover wonderful things.
summary: BONK! A little acorn bounces off Pip's nose, and the curious fox just HAS to find out where it came from! Follow the acorn trail with Pip, Tumble and Hazel through Clover Wood and count from one all the way to ten in this funny animated story about curiosity, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Hazel and the Giggly Rhyme Show
moral: You shine the brightest when you are just being you.
summary: It's Talent Show night in Clover Wood! Pip can juggle (sort of), Tumble can honk, but shy little Hazel thinks she has no talent at all. Learn rhyming words like frog and log, bee and tree, and cat and hat in this funny animated story about being yourself, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Plip-Plop Pond
moral: When we look after nature, every little creature has a happy home.
summary: A windy night blows a whole picnic into Lily Pond, and the little frog's home is a mess! Pip, Hazel, Tumble and Nana Hoot test what floats and what sinks, with lots of PLOOPs, BOINGs and one giant sneeze. A funny animated story about caring for nature, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Hazel and the Five Stepping Stones
moral: Being brave means taking one small step at a time.
summary: Nana Hoot needs blueberries for her pie, but the Big Berry Bush is across Bubbly Brook, and little Hazel the hedgehog feels scared of the five wobbly stepping stones! Count from one to five with Pip, Tumble and Hazel in this funny animated story about courage for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Wobbly Golden Pumpkin
moral: Telling the truth, even when it's hard, makes our hearts feel light.
summary: It's Pumpkin Face Party day in Clover Wood! Pip, Tumble and Hazel paint pumpkins with happy, sad and surprised faces, but Nana Hoot's special Golden Pumpkin is just for looking... Learn the names of feelings like happy, sad, surprised, worried and proud in this funny animated story about honesty, for kids aged 3 to 8.

title: Pip and the Zebra Crossing Mix-Up
moral: When we listen carefully, we stay safe and happy together.
summary: It's Market Day in Clover Wood! Pip can't wait to cross Clover Lane, but first Nana Hoot has a very important rule. Learn to stop, look left and right, and listen at the road with sock bunnies, a zooming snail and one very silly zebra hunt. A funny animated road safety story for kids aged 3 to 8.
